Kaiten Sushi (Revolving Sushi Bar) was created to offer a more relaxed
and accessible dining experience through the kaiten-style concept,
where guests can select sushi directly from a conveyor belt. This format
allows us to provide more affordable pricing while maintaining the high

YOY: Q4’25 VS Q4’24
Gross profit was 278.2 million baht, increased by 88.4 million baht, representing an
increase of 46.6% mainly due to significant growth in revenue from sales and
services, in line with continued business expansion.
Gross profit margin in Q4’25 was 46.6%, remained at a level close to 47.5% in
Q4’24, with the slight decline mainly due to promotional campaigns implemented
during the year-end period to stimulate sales, while effective cost control and
operational efficiency helped maintain margin stability.
Gross profit was 942.6 million baht, increased by 312.7 million baht, representing an
increase of 49.6% mainly due to higher sales and service revenue driven by business
expansion and a favorable revenue mix toward higher-margin brands and menu items,
together with effective cost management and enhanced procurement efficiency.

STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL POSITION
As of December 31, 2025, total liabilities were 1,053.3 million
baht, an increase of 314.0 million baht or 42.5% compared to
December 31, 2024, mainly due to:
 Current liabilities: increased by 125.9 million baht from
higher trade payables and other current payables, as well as
the current portion of lease liabilities related to continuous
branch expansion.
 Non-current liabilities: increased by 188.1 million baht from
additional lease liabilities and other long-term obligations, in
line with branch expansion and overall business growth.
The Company had no borrowings from financial institutions as
of December 31, 2025.As of December 31, 2025, the Company had total
shareholders’ equity of 731.6 million baht, an increase of 79.0
million baht or 12.1% compared to December 31, 2024, mainly
due to:
Shareholders’ Equity: increased primarily from net profit
generated during 2025, which strengthened retained
earnings. The Company maintained an appropriate capital
structure to support long-term growth.As of December 31, 2025, the Company had total assets of 1,784.9 million baht, an
increase of 393.0 million baht or 28.2% compared to December 31, 2024, mainly due
to:
Cash and cash equivalents: increased by 44.7 million baht, in line with higher
operating cash flows and effective liquidity management.
Financial assets (FVPL): decreased to zero, reflecting the disposal or maturity of
investments and the reallocation of funds to support business expansion and
investments in fixed assets.
Building and equipment: increased by 151.3 million baht from investments in the
construction and decoration of 15 new branches, as well as renovations of existing
branches to enhance brand image and overall customer experience.
Other non-current assets: increased by 281.8 million baht, primarily due to the
recognition of additional right-of-use assets from new branch openings and new
lease agreements.
